commands:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
CTRL="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/litegraph/control"
REL=.agent/patches/__pycache__/v4113_onboard_c6_repo.cpython-313.pyc
SHA=838fb36ec204c8f9e13057096a0b95f58126df0f
test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
STATUS=$(git -C "$CTRL" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)
printf 'CONTROL_STATUS_BEFORE=%s\n' "$STATUS"
test "$STATUS" = "?? $REL"
test -f "$CTRL/$REL"
rm -- "$CTRL/$REL"
rmdir "$CTRL/.agent/patches/__pycache__" 2>/dev/null || true
test -z "$(git -C "$CTRL" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
printf 'CONTROL_STATUS_AFTER=clean\n'
